Combined retained_earnings (Parent + Sub), summed directly with no elimination -- correct for a wholly-owned subsidiary with no noncontrolling interest, since only the subsidiary's *original* contributed capital is eliminated against the parent's investment account (see below), not its post-formation earnings: 2026 13000.00+17000.00=30000.00; 2027 26000.00+37000.00=63000.00; 2028 39000.00+60000.00=99000.00; 2029 52000.00+86000.00=138000.00; 2030 65000.00+115000.00=180000.00.

Eliminations, every year: investment_in_subsidiary 100000.00 vs common_stock 100000.00 (constant, never changes) -- equal, eliminated. intercompany_receivable vs intercompany_payable -- 50000.00 vs 50000.00 through 2029, 0.00 vs 0.00 in 2030 (balloon repaid) -- equal every year, eliminated.

Consolidated income statement: each year, Parent's intercompany_interest_income (3000.00) and intercompany_management_fee_revenue (10000.00) are both eliminated against Sub's matching intercompany_interest_expense and intercompany_management_fee_expense -- neither pair appears as a gross line item. Remaining revenue is Sub's external revenue only (80000/85000/90000/95000/100000), remaining expense is Sub's operating_expense only (50000/52000/54000/56000/58000), giving net_income 30000/33000/36000/39000/42000 -- which matches each year's increase in combined retained_earnings above exactly (e.g. 2027: 63000.00 - 30000.00 = 33000.00).
